Confirmed — these all directly invoke `isEnabled` (direct import, direct call), not through a wrapper. The agent's findings check out against my own grep verification.

Based on tracing the call graph in this repo, the predicate is `isEnabled` in `src/lib/feature-flags.ts`. Files that only build a `FlagContext` object (`buildFlagContext`, `orgFlagContext`), hold a snapshot/cache (`snapshotFlags`, `FeatureFlagProvider`, `FlagSnapshotContext`, `tenant-context.ts`, `layout.tsx`), or render the `FeatureGate` component (which delegates to `readFlag`, not `isEnabled`, directly) were excluded. `readFlag` itself (in `flag-context.ts`) does call `isEnabled` directly as a fallback, so that file is included.
